tldr: Officials told CM Revanth Reddy the Phase 1 tender process has started and work will begin in January 2027.

beats.what: Zone-1A is the 9.20-km Himayatsagar to Gandhi Sarovar stretch; Zone-1B is the 11.8-km Osmansagar to Gandhi Sarovar stretch.
beats.why: It came up at a review of Musi, the PRTS pod transit plan, Mir Alam Tank, Koheda fruit market and radial roads.
beats.care: Residents near the river's western stretches could see construction activity from early next year.
